content:
The test image shows a field view with patchy plant death/stunting — some areas have dead or severely wilted plants while adjacent plants look healthy. Sandy soil visible. This pattern suggests a soil-borne pathogen. Top candidates: Pythium_damping_off, Phytophthora, Rhizoctonia, Sudden_death_syndrome, Soybean_Cyst_Nematode.

Let me check reference images one at a time.
Pythium shows seedling-level close-up with rotted stem - not matching the field-level patchy death pattern. Let me check Phytophthora.
Phytophthora shows wilted plants with brown leaves - somewhat matching. Let me check Sudden_death_syndrome.
SDS shows interveinal leaf necrosis - not matching the field-level patchy death. Let me check Soybean_Cyst_Nematode.
Rhizoctonia shows stem close-up. Let me check Charcoal_Rot field view.
Let me check Pythium field view and Phytophthora field view.
This Phytophthora image shows field-level view with mixed dying/healthy plants and sandy soil - similar to the test image! Let me check one more Phytophthora reference.
Charcoal rot shows field-level patchy plant death. Let me check Brown_Stem_Rot and also the Sudden_death_syndrome field view.
Brown Stem Rot shows stem cross-section. Now let me check Sudden_death_syndrome field view and Soybean_Cyst_Nematode field view.
I need to cover more classes. Let me check Fusarium, Septoria, and Soybean_rust.
One more view needed. Let me check SCN field view.

Now I have all 16 views. Let me summarize my analysis:

**Test image key features:**
- Field-level view showing patchy areas of stunted/dead plants
- Surrounding plants look healthy green
- Sandy/dry soil visible
- Differential stand height is striking

**Reference comparison:**
- `Charcoal_Rot/Soybean_Dise_52.jpg` — closest match: field view with dead/brown plants among healthy green plants, dry/sandy soil, similar overhead perspective
- `Phytophthora/Soybean_Dise_57.jpg` — partial match: field-level dying plants with dry soil
- All leaf-spot diseases (Septoria, SDS, SCN) — show close-up leaf/root symptoms, not matching
- Soybean rust — widespread complete field death, too severe
- Pythium — seedling-level close-ups only

The patchy stand death in a sandy/dry field environment with contrasting healthy green plants around the affected areas best matches **Charcoal_Rot**, which is associated with hot, drought-stressed conditions and sandy soils, causing exactly this kind of premature plant death in field patches.
